format: Eight-team senior playoff field, no byes. Quarterfinal 1 is #3 Sharp Strikers vs #6 Amax Visionaries, Quarterfinal 2 is #2 EM Haulers FC vs #7 Gangat Warriors, Quarterfinal 3 is #4 Rawaha Royals vs #5 Refuel Rovers, and Quarterfinal 4 is #1 Leeward Lions vs #8 Memon Mavericks, each 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime, played in that order starting at 8:30 AM. Semifinal 1 is the QF1/QF2 winners and Semifinal 2 is the QF3/QF4 winners, also 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime. Finals Day runs the quarterfinals, semifinals, a Coaches & Volunteers match, Juniors games, a Dhuhr break, and the 45-minute LSL Championship Final at 2:00 PM, all on Saturday, August 8, 2026.
